handcheck_judged.judge_note: gold date-of-death -> cluster#16, a person<->location/association blob (residence/marriage/birthplace/deathplace); no date semantics, DIED_IN is place not date
mother -> cluster#46, 97-member kinship blob (child/sibling/daughter/alias); conflates mother with all other kin, no mother-specific canonical relation
publication-date -> cluster#40 editorial-credit (edited/illustrated/published_by); no date, publication-DATE has no native edge
place-of-birth -> cluster#16; BORN_IN merged with DIED_IN (deathplace)/RESIDES_IN/MARRIED_TO - birthplace not separable
performer -> cluster#39 (performed_by/featured_artist/covered_by); coherent performance cluster, minor venue noise (performed_at); NOT counted (cos 0.510 < 0.6)
gold 'country' is geographic containment (place->country); cluster#17 expresses person nationality/citizenship - a distinct relation
director -> cluster#24 person<->org affiliation blob (attended/member/founder/employed); DIRECTOR_OF buried, does not express film-director. COUNTED (0.788)
date-of-birth -> cluster#46 kinship blob; BORN_ON absorbed into family relations, no date semantics
father -> cluster#46 kinship blob; conflated with CHILD_OF (inverse X_OF direction), SIBLING_OF, DAUGHTER_OF. COUNTED (0.640)
country-of-citizenship -> cluster#17 (has_citizenship/citizen_of/nationality); coherently expresses citizenship; NOT counted (cos 0.581 < 0.6)
child -> cluster#46 kinship blob; CHILD_OF merged with FATHER_OF (inverse direction) and SIBLING_OF. COUNTED (0.608)
place-of-death -> cluster#16; DIED_IN/DIED_AT merged with BORN_IN (birthplace)/RESIDES_IN - deathplace not separable from birthplace
educated-at -> cluster#24; ATTENDED (student) merged with TAUGHT_AT (teacher) plus member/director/founder - the student/teacher role confusion
cause-of-death -> cluster#46 KINSHIP blob; CAUSES_DEATH_OF absorbed into family relations - nonsensical canonical bucket. COUNTED (0.770)
spouse -> cluster#16; MARRIED_TO merged with residence/birthplace/deathplace; spouse not separable from location relations
composer -> cluster#41 creative-credit blob (acted_in/directed/author_of/written_by/produced); distinct creative roles conflated. COUNTED (0.631)
employer -> cluster#24 affiliation blob; EMPLOYED_BY merged with attended/member/director/founder - distinct affiliation roles. COUNTED (0.661)
place-of-detention -> cluster#14 capture/seizure (captured_by/seized_in); does not express imprisonment-location
country-of-origin (of a work) -> cluster#17 person-citizenship cluster; distinct relation conflated
inception (founding date) -> cluster#41 creative-credit blob; no date, wrong relation entirely
sibling -> cluster#46 kinship blob; SIBLING_OF conflated with parent/child (CHILD_OF/FATHER_OF) - sibling not a separable canonical relation. COUNTED (0.881)
founded-by -> cluster#24 affiliation blob; FOUNDED_BY merged with attended/member/director/employed. COUNTED (1.000)
publisher -> cluster#24 affiliation blob; PUBLISHER_OF merged into person<->org affiliation, not separable. COUNTED (0.820)

cluster#24 coherence: affiliation blob (attended/member/founder/director/employed/president/ceo) - many distinct roles
